title: What's New: Business Central Agent Instruction History

chapters.title: Accessing History Features in Business Central UI

features.name: Agent Instruction History Autosave
features.description: Automatically saves all instructions typed in the agent playground and creates a version in the instruction history each time a task is run, ensuring no work is lost.

features.name: Manual Save to History
features.description: Allows users to manually save specific instruction versions to history with custom names for easy identification and retrieval of important versions.

features.name: Download Instructions
features.description: Exports individual instruction versions to disk for backup or analysis in external tools like Visual Studio Code or Beyond Compare.
caveats: Instruction history is not exported when exporting the agent

features.name: View Instruction History
features.description: Displays all saved instruction versions arranged by timestamp, allowing users to quickly find and navigate through different versions of instructions.

features.name: Multi-select Download Versions
features.description: Enables users to select multiple instruction versions and download them together as a zipped file for batch export and comparison.

features.name: Instruction Version Naming
features.description: Allows users to assign custom names to instruction versions to help quickly identify what changes or functionality each version represents.
